argv: B=$TMPDIR/base/skills/confidence-protocol; mkdir -p $B/scripts $B/tests; for f in scripts/confidence.py scripts/diagnostics.py tests/test_diagnostics.py; do git show HEAD:skills/confidence-protocol/$f > $B/$f 2>/dev/null; done; env -u CONFIDENCE_DISABLE_DIAGNOSTICS python3 -B -m unittest discover -s $B/tests -p test_diagnostics.py -k test_doctor_reports_required_health_checks 2>$TMPDIR/b.txt; echo baseline_rc=$? > $TMPDIR/r4; grep -E 'AssertionError|^Ran' $TMPDIR/b.txt >> $TMPDIR/r4; while IFS= read -r l; do echo "$l"; done < $TMPDIR/r4
